name: Naturalistic Terrarium (12" W x 12" D x 18" H")
description: This terrarium's front glass opens and closes with a snap closure, allowing easy cleaning and unobstructed views of the interior. A watertight base lets you have the best of both worlds - aquarium and terrarium! The special built-in screen top keeps feeder insects in while allowing ample UVA and UVB penetration. And the noncorrosive stainless-steel lid accommodates a standard clamp lamp. Dimensions, 12" W x 12" D x 18" H.
